title: How to Decide Whether ElevenLabs Video Translation Fits Your Workflow
markdown:
If you are evaluating a video-translation tool, begin with the work you need completed rather than with a plan name. ElevenLabs’ Translate Video page says its browser-based workflow lets you upload a video, choose source and target languages, generate a translation, then preview, refine, and export the result. [Source](https://elevenlabs.io/translate-video)

A practical fit check starts with inputs. The product page lists MP4, MOV, and AVI as supported upload types, and says the service supports translations between more than 90 languages. It also describes exports as text transcripts (TXT), subtitle files (SRT or VTT), or dubbed MP4 video. Confirm that your intended file type, language pair, and delivery format match these stated options before relying on the workflow. [Source](https://elevenlabs.io/translate-video)

Next, consider how much editorial control you need. According to ElevenLabs, you can review translations, adjust timing, edit subtitles in the browser, and adjust tone, pacing, or delivery. Those controls may be relevant if a translated version needs review before publishing; the page does not remove the need to assess the output against your own content requirements. [Source](https://elevenlabs.io/translate-video)

Cost should be checked against the current plan details. ElevenLabs lists a Free plan at $0 per month with 10,000 credits, while its pricing FAQ says credits are shared across products and gives approximate dubbing costs per minute that vary by dubbing method and watermark option. Prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties. Review the pricing page directly for the current plan, credits, and applicable usage before making a purchase decision. [Source](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

For a low-commitment evaluation, test one representative clip, inspect the translated text, subtitles, timing, and exported format, then decide whether it works for your publishing process.

Disclosure: This article contains an affiliate link.

Try the video translation workflow here: https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-translate-video-en-1
